description: Deterministic six-conversation Northstar history for Threadkeeper demo and QA.

messages.content: I want to launch a weekly newsletter called Northstar. I still need to buy the domain, publish a landing page, and draft issue zero. The smallest useful launch is a clear landing page, the domain, and one first issue.
Captured the Northstar launch work: buy the domain, publish the landing page, and draft issue zero. The intended cadence is weekly.

The client briefing format worked well: select five important developments, explain why each matters, then give one recommended action. I want a reusable source-monitoring workflow rather than a long link dump.
The reusable structure is five developments, why they matter, and one recommended action, backed by a repeatable monitoring workflow.

Northstar could expand beyond a newsletter into interviews, a podcast, and a research database. The scope has become too large to launch right now. I am blocked by the expanding scope, but I am not declaring the project abandoned.
Recorded a scope-expansion event and an unresolved launch blocker. The evidence does not establish permanent abandonment.

Actually, monthly is better than weekly. Weekly was too much. I bought the Northstar domain, but the landing page still is not published. Keep weekly as historical context, but the current cadence should be monthly.
The domain purchase is complete. The weekly cadence is superseded by a monthly cadence, and the landing page remains open.

I want a repeatable way to turn monitoring research into short, actionable analysis. The client briefing structure of five developments, why they matter, and one action could be reused for a newsletter issue.
This may connect the client briefing workflow to Northstar as a possible issue structure. Treat that as a proposal, not a fact.

I am restarting Northstar. Issue zero is drafted, but the landing page is still unpublished. I want to publish the page by August 20, 2026. Drafting issue zero is complete; publishing the landing page is still open.
Northstar is active again after dormancy. Issue zero is complete. The landing-page publication loop remains open with a due date of August 20, 2026.
